title: The Jedi Council’s Plan
front_description: Deeply concerned about Senator Amidala's safety, the Jedi realims they must act quickly and decisively before another near-tragedy occurs. Obi-Wan Kenobi is assigned to investigate a lead -the toxic dart- to unmask her eager assassins. Anakin, meanwhile, is assigned a different duty... he must put aside his deep personal feelings for Padmé while escorting the imperiled Senator to her home planet of Naboo.
back_description: Star Wars creator George Lucas directs Ewan McGregor and Samuel L. Jackson.
